initiatives.name: U.S. Domestic Rare Earth Supply Chain Strategy
initiatives.summary: MP is commissioning a new heavy rare earth separation facility at Mountain Pass designed to process 3,000 MT of feedstock per year. The facility will initially prioritize dysprosium and terbium production with a nameplate capacity of 200 MT per year.

evidence.title: Heavy Rare Earth Separation Facility Commissioning
evidence.summary: MP is commissioning a new heavy rare earth separation facility at Mountain Pass designed to process 3,000 MT of feedstock per year. The facility will initially prioritize dysprosium and terbium production with a nameplate capacity of 200 MT per year.
evidence.quote: MP plans to begin commissioning its new heavy rare earth separation facility at Mountain Pass in mid-2026. The facility is designed to process approximately 3,000 MT of feedstock per year and will initially prioritize production of dysprosium (Dy) and terbium (Tb).

evidence.title: Department of War Price Protection Agreement
evidence.summary: MP commenced a Price Protection Agreement with the U.S. Department of War starting October 1, 2025. This agreement provides enhanced cash flow visibility and supports the company's transition to scaled magnet production in the United States.
evidence.quote: DoW Price Protection Agreement commenced October 1, 2025

evidence.title: Cessation of All Sales to China
evidence.summary: MP ceased all sales of products to China to align with Department of War agreements and support domestic supply chain objectives. This resulted in no rare earth concentrate revenue during Q3 2025, representing a significant strategic shift.
evidence.quote: To align with the terms of the recent agreements with the United States Department of War (the "DoW"), formerly known as the Department of Defense, and in further support of our domestic supply chain objectives, we ceased all sales of our products to China, which resulted in no revenue recognized from rare earth concentrate during the quarter

initiatives.name: Green Financing Framework
initiatives.summary: MP Materials established a comprehensive Green Financing Framework to guide environmentally responsible financing for future growth. The framework prioritizes projects in sustainable water management, energy efficiency, renewable energy, and eco-efficient products with dedicated governance committee oversight.

evidence.title: Green Financing Framework Implementation
evidence.summary: MP Materials established a comprehensive Green Financing Framework to guide environmentally responsible financing for future growth. The framework prioritizes projects in sustainable water management, energy efficiency, renewable energy, and eco-efficient products with dedicated governance committee oversight.
evidence.quote: MP Materials Corp. (MP, the Company, we, or us) issued a Green Financing Framework (Framework) in March 2021, consistent with its sustainability objectives. The Framework guides an environmentally and socially responsible approach to financing future growth. It provides governance over the stewardship of the Company's financings and prioritizes projects related to sustainable water management, energy efficiency, renewable energy, and eco- efficient products.

initiatives.name: Independence Facility Magnet Production Scaling
initiatives.summary: MP is scaling commercial magnet production with first commercial output from its Independence facility expected by year-end 2025. The company plans to produce 10,000 MT of high-performance NdFeB magnets per year.

evidence.title: Commercial Magnet Production at Independence Facility
evidence.summary: MP is scaling commercial magnet production with first commercial output from its Independence facility expected by year-end 2025. The company plans to produce 10,000 MT of high-performance NdFeB magnets per year.
evidence.quote: we now have enhanced cash flow visibility to accelerate scaled magnet production in the United States —beginning with first commercial output from Independence by year-end.

initiatives.name: Stage III Finished Products Development
initiatives.summary: MP is implementing Stage III development plan to enable production of finished products for specific end uses in clean energy, electric vehicles, and LED lighting. This represents a strategic move toward downstream manufacturing and value-added products.

evidence.title: Stage III Finished Products Development Plan
evidence.summary: MP is implementing Stage III development plan to enable production of finished products for specific end uses in clean energy, electric vehicles, and LED lighting. This represents a strategic move toward downstream manufacturing and value-added products.
evidence.quote: Investments consistent with MP's Stage III development plan, which enable production of finished products with specific end uses in (i) clean energy technologies, such as generators in wind power turbines, (ii) clean transportation technologies, such as traction motors in electric vehicles and hybrid electric vehicles, and (iii) essential industrial infrastructure, such as LED lighting.

initiatives.name: Stage II Rare Earth Processing Expansion
initiatives.summary: MP is developing facilities dedicated to future extraction and processing of neodymium-praseodymium as part of Stage II development plan. These investments focus on facilities for products used in clean-energy and transportation technologies.

evidence.title: Stage II Rare Earth Processing Facilities
evidence.summary: MP is developing facilities dedicated to future extraction and processing of neodymium-praseodymium as part of Stage II development plan. These investments focus on facilities for products used in clean-energy and transportation technologies.
evidence.quote: Development, operation, and maintenance of MP's (i) facilities dedicated to the future extraction and processing of neodymium-praseodymium, corresponding to Stage II of MP's development plan, (ii) facilities dedicated to the future extraction and processing of heavy rare earths and/or the recycling of rare earths.
